issue_context.title: [Enhancement] Add namespace v2 in client
issue_context.body:
### Before Creating the Enhancement Request

- [X] I have confirmed that this should be classified as an enhancement rather than a bug/feature.


### Summary

1. Add namespace v2 in client
2. Add NamespaceRpcHook

### Motivation

Currently, our namespace implementation relies on a concatenation-based approach. Contrary to this, we are proposing a new namespace scheme that will be integrated into the protocol through RPC hooks

### Describe the Solution You'd Like

Implement namespace in the protocol.

### Describe Alternatives You've Considered

No

### Additional Context

_No response_

review_comments: This shall result in a backward compatible issue.
Only the function signature has been modified here, without changes to the internal fields. The field name remains 'bname', so there should be no compatibility issues.
